rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 covers a passive, negative or half-hearted attitude.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 identifies prize money or a monetary award.
rows.sourceNote: Money is distinguished from an awarded physical item and from winning itself.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse the existing jouge article for upper/lower positions and rising/falling; the existing hierarchy and clothing-set explanations also map to senses 4 and 6.
rows.sourceNote: Only jlpt 2 is added. Preserve identity, reading, title, body and other metadata. Raw unloading/loading and praising/blaming are retained as compiler glosses, not attributed to the pinned jouge family. The public page's separate shouka heading is not transferred to jouge; the compiler's precise intent for those extra English glosses is not recovered.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole pinned sense 1 identifies the paper-covered sliding fitting.
rows.sourceNote: Teach the ordinary modern shoji, not every historical partition or separate slang use. 子 in this object name is not literally child.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 identifies a trading company.
rows.sourceNote: Raw firm is qualified rather than extended to every company or shop. Import/export is an important association, not a mandatory international condition for every transaction.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole pinned sense 1 includes train/bus boarding and getting into a taxi.
rows.sourceNote: Raw train-only wording is not an exclusive definition. Intransitive suru with a vehicle marked by ni; boarding does not imply driving or arrival.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 identifies days 1-10 of a month.
rows.sourceNote: First third is a conventional rendering, not a variable arithmetic division of month length. 中旬 is 11-20 and 下旬 21 through month-end.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; raw cause/arise selects the transitive producing/cause sense 1 and intransitive arising sense 2.
rows.sourceNote: More literary than 生じる. Preserve the pinned zuru/ichidan-alternative POS while acknowledging actual Daijisen's sahen classification. Teach complete particle constructions and usable conjugated forms without presenting an ordinary godan paradigm.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; mathematical fraction/decimal wording selects sense 2.
rows.sourceNote: Sense 1 small number/amount is additional recognition. Distinguish decimal notation from 分数 and ordinary 少数 spelling; decimals are not restricted to numbers below one.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse the existing shouten shop/store article for sole pinned sense 1.
rows.sourceNote: Only jlpt 2 is added. Preserve identity, reading, title, body and other metadata. Raw business firm is not permission to redefine the article as every business organization.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; optical focus sense 1 and issue/attention focus sense 2 are explicit teaching anchors for the broad focus/point gloss.
rows.sourceNote: The raw gloss does not disambiguate physical from figurative focus. Technical geometry sense 3 is additional recognition. 商店 is a homophone, not identity reuse.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 identifies disinfection with transitive suru.
rows.sourceNote: Retain raw and pinned sterilization glosses as provenance without teaching an absolute guarantee of killing every organism. Actual MHLW definition section supports the bounded qualification, not a formal definition of 滅菌 or product-use advice.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 identifies victory/defeat and the outcome of a contest.
rows.sourceNote: Noun, not an ordinary suru verb for competing. Neither a claim that one side won nor the same unrestricted contest-event sense as 勝負:2.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; raw evaporation and unexplained disappearance select physical sense 1 and colloquial person-disappearance sense 2.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive suru. Evaporation is not restricted to boiling; disappearance is not a physical transformation of a human body. Public proper-title containers are not extra ordinary lexical senses.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 identifies a prize item or trophy.
rows.sourceNote: Not every award item is a trophy. Distinguish money 賞金 and merchandise 商品; the latter's existing easier jlpt 3 is untouched.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; raw victory/defeat and match/contest wording selects senses 1 and 2.
rows.sourceNote: Noun for outcomes or encounters; intransitive suru for competing, with opponent to. Compare whole constructions with 勝敗 rather than claiming the two words never overlap.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and primary shouben reading; urine/urination sense 1 matches the bodily raw gloss.
rows.sourceNote: Established alternate shonben is retained as recognition, while search-only ション便/ションベン are not promoted. Colloquial contract-breaking sense 2 is additional. Raw colloquial English does not establish a blanket Japanese offensiveness rating.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; sole sense 1 identifies a fire station.
rows.sourceNote: Institution/building is distinguished from firefighting, personnel and vehicle; final sho is short. Both 防 and 署 receive reciprocal primary N2 examples.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and reading; raw net weight explicitly selects sense 2.
rows.sourceNote: Net/effective amount or working hours sense 1, net/cost price sense 3 and actual contents sense 4 are additional. No universal deduction-of-tax or sale-price rule.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source spelling and shoumen reading; pinned sense 1 anchors front/frontage.
rows.sourceNote: Raw honesty is not taught as an unrestricted shoumen noun. The inspected public shoumen direct-facing extension supports head-on issue handling, while its separate matomo heading remains separate. 正面切って has pinned lexical evidence but no successful public lexical-body extraction and is not taught as a verified public construction.

governmentDefinitionInspection.section: 参考情報１ 「消毒」と「除菌」について
governmentDefinitionInspection.inspectedText: 【参考情報１ 「消毒」と「除菌」について】 「消毒」は、菌やウイルスを無毒化することです。「薬機法」（※１）に基づき、厚生労働大臣が品質・有効性・安全性を確認した「医薬品・医薬部外品」の製品に記されています。 「除菌」は、菌やウイルスの数を減らすことです。「医薬品・医薬部外品」以外の製品に記されることが多いようです。「消毒」の語は使いませんが、実際には細菌やウイルスを無毒化できる製品もあります（一部の洗剤や漂白剤など）。 なお、「医薬品・医薬部外品」の「消毒剤」であっても、それ以外の「除菌剤」であっても、全ての菌やウイルスに効果があるわけではなく、新型コロナウイルスに有効な製品は一部であることに注意が必要です。
governmentDefinitionInspection.supportedClaim: 消毒 concerns making pathogens harmless; ordinary 消毒 wording is not a guarantee of effectiveness against every microorganism or of complete sterility.
governmentDefinitionInspection.limits: Only this definition section was inspected for lexical qualification. This is not a verification of the entire page, treatment instructions, or a formal definition of 滅菌.

failedEntryInspections.result: No SGKDJ lexical body extracted; not positive verification.

unmatchedExactDictionaryRequests.basis: The full hash-verified JMdict scan returned these exact requested forms as unmatched before writing family outputs.
unmatchedExactDictionaryRequests.limits: Missing exact dictionary forms do not establish invalid Japanese, absence from another dictionary, or a JLPT level. The original request inventory is retained.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses, not reviewer conclusions. Direct ordinary meanings and actual answer labels govern symmetric nontransitive guards; no homophone-only or inferred clique exclusions.
賞金/賞品 each safeguard the broader prize/award label 賞, without equating a monetary award and an item prize. 商品's merchandise is not automatically a prize.

障子 safeguards the broad door label ドア; other architectural openings and all kinds of partitions are not automatically synonymous. 商社 safeguards broader company/enterprise labels, not every shop or commercial activity.
乗車 safeguards boarding/getting-on 乗る, not driving a vehicle, a vehicle itself or alighting. 上旬 safeguards the broader beginning labels 初め/始め/最初, not a whole month or every early period.
生ずる safeguards actual arise/produce/cause/emerge meanings including 基づく's arise-from sense. Shared source/result subject matter alone does not imply a guard.
焦点 safeguards optical/issue focus and ordinary center/point/key-point/concentration labels, including 点, without collapsing every optical instrument or issue topic.

勝敗 safeguards 勝負 and 結果 for the contest-outcome meaning. 勝負 separately safeguards actual match/game/contest/competition/battle meanings including the broad organized competitive event 大会. No transitive 結果-to-every-contest clique is inferred.
蒸発 safeguards 消える for actual disappearance, not liquid/gas nouns or every chemical process. 小便 safeguards トイレ's toilet/urination overlap; word registration is not identical to English register.

消防署 safeguards 消防's fire-department/service overlap, not a fire vehicle or individual firefighter. 正味 safeguards actual weight/net-price/actual-contents overlaps with 重量/価格/値段/内容; not every quantity or fee.
正面 safeguards 前/表/面 for front-facing surface/side meanings, not every direction or unrelated senses of those polysemous cards.
消極的 has no prudence/pessimism-only guard. 小数 and homophone 少数 have distinct current answer meanings. 消毒 names disinfection, not merely cleanliness; there is no hygiene-topic clique.
sourceAccessLimits: Eighteen new articles and narrow 上下/商店 reuse cover twenty community-list rows N2:762-N2:781, not an official modern JLPT syllabus.
Seven primary reciprocal pairs across six N2 cards: 極/消極的, 賞/賞金, 賞/賞品, 毒/消毒, 蒸/蒸発, 署/消防署, 防/消防署. No new kanji/stroke cards.
Existing 上下 and 商店 gain only sourced explicit jlpt 2; preserve identities/readings/titles/bodies/other metadata. Other readings' public headings are not transferred.
Selected and additional senses remain separate; additional senses do not independently acquire N2. Raw English glosses remain verbatim separately from qualified teaching.

The original 412-family/1117-sense capture is not wholly inspected; only the selected 239 and two supplemental families are counted. The 230 captured bodies are not all read; 74 explicitly inventoried bodies are.
正面切って lacked an extracted actual public lexical body and is not taught as an independently verified construction. Unmatched exact forms 揚げ下ろし/正しさ do not establish invalid Japanese.
MHLW evidence covers only its 消毒/除菌 definition section, not the entire page, product guidance or a formal 滅菌 standard.
No production quiz draws, exhaustive baseline linguistic rereview, measured learning outcomes or native-speaker certification. Blind derivative removes only quizGuardRationale.
